{"id": "IP7PU3AO7Mc", "snippet": {"title": "FTX's code gave one customer a $65 billion line of credit. Its founders owned that customer. #Shorts", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Full episode ▶ https://youtu.be/Hx17Rhhwn98

According to Gary Wang's trial testimony, as summarised by the Second Circuit, special privileges in FTX's code gave Alameda Research a $65 billion line of credit. The court says the arrangement let Alameda keep negative balances. Alameda was co-owned by FTX's founders.

Sources: Second Circuit Court of Appeals, United States v. Bankman-Fried, No. 24-961-cr, opinion (12 Jun 2026); US Supreme Court, docket No. 26-349, Bankman-Fried v. United States; US Attorney's Office SDNY, 'Samuel Bankman-Fried Sentenced To 25 Years In Prison' (28 Mar 2024) (full list in the episode description).
Narration uses a synthetic voice; graphics are our own.

{"id": "tCV4xUmmWJM", "snippet": {"title": "FTX payments were approved with emojis. It's in a sworn bankruptcy declaration. #Shorts", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Full episode ▶ https://youtu.be/Hx17Rhhwn98

John J. Ray III, who took over FTX on 11 November 2022, said in his sworn first-day declaration that disbursements were approved by responding with personalised emojis, that there was no accurate list of bank accounts, and that corporate funds bought homes for employees and advisors.

Sources: Second Circuit Court of Appeals, United States v. Bankman-Fried, No. 24-961-cr, opinion (12 Jun 2026); US Supreme Court, docket No. 26-349, Bankman-Fried v. United States; US Attorney's Office SDNY, 'Samuel Bankman-Fried Sentenced To 25 Years In Prison' (28 Mar 2024) (full list in the episode description).
Narration uses a synthetic voice; graphics are our own.

{"id": "KvErkTJDODo", "snippet": {"title": "FTX repaid customers 105%. But their bitcoin was priced at $16,871. #Shorts", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Full episode ▶ https://youtu.be/Hx17Rhhwn98

FTX customers have been repaid 105% of their claims, but claims were valued in dollars on the 11 November 2022 petition date, when bitcoin was worth $16,871. Judge John Dorsey wrote that claims must be valued as of the petition date as if the bankruptcy had never occurred.

Sources: Second Circuit Court of Appeals, United States v. Bankman-Fried, No. 24-961-cr, opinion (12 Jun 2026); US Supreme Court, docket No. 26-349, Bankman-Fried v. United States; US Attorney's Office SDNY, 'Samuel Bankman-Fried Sentenced To 25 Years In Prison' (28 Mar 2024) (full list in the episode description).
